qs.vlm: ♦ Και φωνησας φωνῇ μεγαλῇ ὁ Ἰησους, ειπε. Dr Campbell's translation is simply, "And Jesus said with a loud voice, Father," &c. Dr Macknight says, "Matthew, Mark, and Luke, tell us that, in speaking these words ("It is finished"), Jesus cried with an exceeding loud voice." —The use of the word in the first Aorist, φωνησας, is in favour of our version, rather than the other; Ἡ δε ἀναβοησασα μεγαλῇ τῇ φωνῇ, Μη μοι προσιτε, φησι, θηρια—*Polybius*, xv. 27; which words are thus translated by Raphelius: Illa clamore edito, Ne me, ait voce alta, O feræ accedatis. In Matt. xxvii. 46, the form of expression is different, Ἀνεβοησεν ὁ Ἰησους φωνῇ μεγαλῇ, λεγων· Ἠλι, &c.
